result.brief: 提出并行姿态与RGB流的音乐驱动舞蹈视频生成框架，结合时间步感知姿态注入与持久身份注入，并构建同步音乐、3D动作与相机参数的高分辨率数据集。
result.reason: Music-driven dance video generation with parallel pose and RGB streams, timestep-aware pose injection, and long-video identity preservation directly serves controllable video generation and audio-video alignment.
